hooks.command:
cli="$HOME/.config/niyam/bin/niyam"; [ -x "$cli" ] || cli=niyam; if [ "${CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE:-}" = true ] && ! command -v "$cli" >/dev/null 2>&1; then setup="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.github/niyam/cloud-setup.sh"; if [ ! -f "$setup" ]; then printf '%s
' "niyam: this cloud session has no niyam, and the clone has no .github/niyam/cloud-setup.sh to install it from; run niyam onboard, which writes it."; elif failed=$(bash "$setup" </dev/null 2>&1 >/dev/null); then printf '%s
' "niyam: this cloud session had no niyam, so the SessionStart hook installed it from .github/niyam/cloud-setup.sh."; else printf '%s
' "niyam: this cloud session has no niyam, and installing it from .github/niyam/cloud-setup.sh as $(id -un) (uid $(id -u)) failed: $(printf '%s
' "$failed" | tail -n 1)"; fi; fi; if said=$("$cli" session-start 2>&1); then printf '%s
' "$said"; else printf '%s
' "niyam: STOP. niyam session-start did not run here ($said), so this session cannot be given the agent identity and GitHub is locked out of it. Do not push, fetch, or run gh in this session; tell the owner."; fi

input=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | sed -nE 's/.*"command"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"(([^"\\]|\\.)*)".*/\1/p'); printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq '(^|[^[:alnum:]_-])(gh|git)([^[:alnum:]_-]|$)' || exit 0; cli="$HOME/.config/niyam/bin/niyam"; [ -x "$cli" ] || cli=niyam; printf '%s' "$input" | "$cli" guard && exit 0; [ $? -eq 2 ] && exit 2; echo "niyam: refused, because the niyam CLI did not run here to check this command. Do not work around it; tell the owner." >&2; exit 2

env.GIT_SSH_COMMAND: echo 'niyam: SSH is off in agent sessions; GitHub goes over HTTPS' >&2; false
